name.zh: 徒手单腿罗马尼亚硬拉

purpose.zh: 徒手单腿罗马尼亚硬拉，练腘绳肌与平衡
purpose.en: Train the hamstrings, hips and balance with a controlled bodyweight single-leg hip hinge.

text.zh: 支撑腿膝微屈，以髋为轴前倾，骨盆保持端平
text.en: Soften the supporting knee, hinge forwards at the hip, and keep your pelvis level

text.zh: 左脚踩稳支撑，右腿随躯干前倾向后抬起
text.en: Keep the left foot planted and let the right leg lift behind as the torso hinges forwards.

text.zh: 背部自然延长，手臂垂在肩部下方，不主动耸肩
text.en: Keep the back long and let the arms hang below the shoulders without shrugging.

text.zh: 到舒适范围后平稳回正，完成左侧剂量再换边
text.en: Return smoothly from a comfortable range and finish the left-side dose before changing sides.

commonErrors.zh: 弓背或向外翻髋，后腿与躯干方向脱节
commonErrors.en: Rounding the back, opening the pelvis or letting the rear leg move out of line with the torso.

commonErrors.zh: 锁死支撑膝、扭脚或靠甩腿找平衡
commonErrors.en: Locking the supporting knee, twisting the planted foot or swinging the rear leg to balance.

items.zh: 腰与骨盆：以髋折叠，骨盆保持朝向地面，不以弓背或开髋加深。
items.en: Lower back and pelvis: hinge at the hip with the pelvis square rather than rounding the back or opening the hip.

items.zh: 支撑膝踝与平衡：左膝微屈，左足持续稳定；只前倾到能平稳回正的幅度。
items.en: Supporting knee, ankle and balance: keep the left knee soft and foot steady, and hinge only as far as you can return under control.

items.zh: 本动作引发疼痛时停止，不通过增加幅度或负重继续；先向医生或物理治疗师确认。
items.en: Stop if this exercise causes pain; do not add range or load before seeking clinical advice.

items.zh: 已有医嘱限制单腿负重、站立平衡或髋部前倾时，先取得许可。
items.en: Obtain clearance first if single-leg loading, standing balance or hip hinging has been restricted.

definition.countingSemantics: One hinge and return on the supporting leg counts as one rep. Default reps=8 is per side, as explicitly prescribed in the legacy FlareLab record. The 8-second clip shows two left-support reps, with the right leg lifted behind, and no side change. Complete four loops for the default left-side dose before an optional external change; opposite-side media is not produced.
definition.movementSides: Only the left support/working leg is demonstrated; the right leg lifts behind. Eight seconds is an available loop-boundary cue after the prescribed per-side dose, not an encoded or mandatory every-loop switch.
editorialNotes: 旧FlareLab明确3组×每侧8次；默认8为每侧，源每8秒仅左支撑2次，因此左侧默认4loops后才能提示换边，不是每loop强制换。
startingSide=left指支撑/主要训练腿，右腿是后抬腿；source.highlight.side=both原样保留，不能伪称仅左侧高亮。
原spec无modelProfile，保留左腿reach168和原solver；原stillAt0.2秒为准备位，batch peak选2秒。h-good-morning为原目录明确、减少单腿平衡要求的双足髋铰链替代/降阶，非同等平衡刺激；独立同模式负重进阶ID未核定。
相位来自catalog/v2/batches/b002.json真实源时间；剂量数字与范围保持旧catalog。rhythm只描述动画，不使用旧reps或holdSeconds来覆盖处方。
具体双语注意、通用禁用筛查、协同肌群与关系均为待审草稿；协同包含稳定/次要拉伸角色，不是额外高亮或肌电激活结论。
关系均为本仓库真实ID候选，不等于已有同模型可发布v2包；不得自动回退弃用模型素材。空关系缺口见逐动作说明。
通用医学筛查证据边界沿用catalog/v2/definition-evidence.md的AAOS/NHS一手资料；不编造疾病特异绝对禁忌，编辑/医学审核均保持pending。

switchPoint.semantics: Only the left support/working leg is demonstrated; the right leg lifts behind. Eight seconds is an available loop-boundary cue after the prescribed per-side dose, not an encoded or mandatory every-loop switch. One hinge and return on the supporting leg counts as one rep. Default reps=8 is per side, as explicitly prescribed in the legacy FlareLab record. The 8-second clip shows two left-support reps, with the right leg lifted behind, and no side change. Complete four loops for the default left-side dose before an optional external change; opposite-side media is not produced.
